entry_state: The banking chapter distinguishes reported group relationships, parent cash and earnings, conditional upstream transfers, dividend declaration rules and bank-specific capital constraints. Systemic indicators need their own units, vintages and applicable rule; proposals are not operative rules. Debt carrying values, dated principal and guarantee terms answer different questions. Loan creation and expected credit loss remain to follow.
exit_state: The debt discussion continues through default notice, holder remedies and successor conditions; its earlier node span needs a supplemental correction. Loan origination, external settlement, commitment exposure and allowance measurement are distinct. Accounting equity requires instrument-specific prudential reconciliation. The bank path now constructs gross exposure, admitted allowance and excess allowance before calculating regulatory ratios; the reconciliation table continues next.
findings: Review-record correction required: the debt subsection spans 248–251, not 248–249. Pages 250–251 add default, remedy, amendment and succession terms; original segment remains preserved.
Commitment date, public announcement, expected acquisition closing and future drawn portfolio are kept distinct.

The prudential example constructs the gross exposure base before the allowance cap and excess deduction; its historical rules and conditional applicability remain explicit. No new manuscript defect confirmed.
